full_text:
Lee Roy is a dangerous and powerful Seeker who works for the Organization.

== History ==
Lee Roy fought against Dante Vale's team whilst trying to find the Titan Thunderok. [The Titan of the Stage]

== Abilities ==
Lee Roy is highly skilled martial artist and possesses great physical strength. In addition, he can rely on a powerful roster of Titans to fight by his side. [The Titan of the Stage]
===Bonded Titans===
*Bonelasher
*Executioner
